native_files.origin: BioCreative V CDR task release archive (CDR_Data.zip), unzipped.

contents.README.txt: NCBI public-domain notice and citation list for the BC5CDR corpus.
contents.CDR.Corpus.v010516/: Main corpus, three splits in BioC XML and PubTator text formats.
Training split, 500 abstracts, BioC XML with chemicals/diseases/CID relations.
contents.CDR.Corpus.v010516/CDR_TrainingSet.PubTa: Same training split in PubTator stand-off text format.
contents.CDR.Corpus.v010516/CDR_DevelopmentSet.Pu: Same dev split in PubTator format.
Same test split in PubTator format.
contents.DNorm.TestSet/: DNorm baseline disease-normalization output on the test set (BioC XML and PubTator).
contents.tmChem.TestSet/: tmChem baseline chemical-NER output on the test set (BioC XML and PubTator).

native_files.relationship_to_jsonl: train/validation/test.jsonl in this folder are produced by the bigbio loading script from CDR_TrainingSet/CDR_DevelopmentSet/CDR_TestSet.BioC.xml. The DNorm and tmChem subfolders are baseline system outputs, not gold annotations.

id: Row index within the JSONL file. Not the PMID.

passages.text: The passage text in a one-element list.
passages.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the passage. The title passage starts at 0; the abstract passage starts at len(title) + 1 (the corpus joins them with one space).

entities.text: The entity text in a one-element list.
entities.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the entity.

normalized.db_id: MeSH descriptor id, e.g. 'D009270' for Naloxone.

relations.arg1_id: Entity id of the first argument.
relations.arg2_id: Entity id of the second argument.
